findings.evidence: Both `toWedderburnPresentation` definitions are exactly `P.toWedderburnAlgebraPresentation.toWedderburnPresentation` (lines 190–192 and 262–264), while all component projection/equivalence lemmas are already `[simp]` at lines 147–165, 195–213, and 267–285.
findings.fix: Delete these eight composite lemmas; consumers can use `simp [toWedderburnPresentation]` with `toWedderburnAlgebraPresentation_*` and `WedderburnAlgebraPresentation.toWedderburnPresentation_*`.
findings.issue: The four `SplitWedderburnAlgebraPresentation.toWedderburnPresentation_*` lemmas (lines 216–234) and four corresponding `WedderburnEndomorphismPresentation` lemmas (lines 288–306) duplicate results obtained by composing the existing algebra-presentation and algebra-to-ring `[simp]` lemmas.

summary: The direct-to-ring simp API for split and endomorphism presentations duplicates the component conversion simp lemmas already defined in the same file.
